evals.prompt: Audit eval1_identity_churn.swift for SwiftUI render bottlenecks, identity churn, and view graph invalidations. Propose surgical fixes.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying ForEach id: \.self identity instability on mutated struct, AnyView type erasure, and volatile explicit .id(UUID()) view graph destruction with @ViewBuilder and stable ID fixes.
expectations: Identifies ForEach with id: \.self on mutated Hashable struct causing identity instability
Identifies AnyView type erasure destroying compile-time structural diffing
Identifies volatile explicit .id(UUID()) destroying subview state and resetting view graph
Recommends @ViewBuilder or concrete view hierarchy and stable Identifiable IDs

evals.prompt: Audit eval2_body_computation.swift for SwiftUI render and scroll hitch bottlenecks.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging DateFormatter instantiation inside body, unmemoized .sorted()/.filter() array computations during render, and eager VStack in ScrollView.
expectations: Identifies DateFormatter instantiation inside body as high-cost allocation
Identifies array .filter() and .sorted() called in body causing main thread computation stalls
Identifies eager VStack inside ScrollView causing all rows to be instantiated immediately
Suggests LazyVStack, static/cached DateFormatter or FormatStyle, and pre-computed ViewModel properties

evals.prompt: Audit eval3_observation_invalidation.swift for SwiftUI state over-invalidation and observation issues.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying missing @ObservationIgnored on background properties, coarse observable store passing to leaf views, and inline @ObservedObject instantiation.
expectations: Identifies inline @ObservedObject instantiation recreating store on every parent render
Identifies passing entire observable store to MetricBadgeView instead of primitive value type
Identifies missing @ObservationIgnored on background timer and non-UI state in @Observable class
Recommends state slicing, primitive property injection, and @ObservationIgnored annotations

evals.prompt: Audit eval4_lifecycle_traps.swift for SwiftUI lifecycle anti-patterns, state synchronization traps, and presentation leaks.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying @State in init() desynchronization trap, side-effects in view init(), sheet modifier inside ForEach loop, and unstructured Task in onAppear.
expectations: Identifies @State initialized in init() from parameter causing stale state bug
Identifies side-effects / analytics logging in view struct init()
Identifies .sheet modifier placed inside ForEach loop allocating N presentation coordinators
Identifies unstructured Task inside .onAppear lacking automatic lifecycle cancellation
Recommends @Binding, hoisting sheet to parent, and replacing .onAppear Task with .task modifier
